environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) running behind a classic ELB with TCP passthrough on port 443. No additional middleware or filtering layers. The Flask app is served via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database contains user records including password hashes and PII. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP mode (no HTTP inspection)
